_comment: Runs of the grid study (~/.naoqi-pilot/grid) kept on disk but not part of the pilot or the main runs, with the reason. pilot/metrics.py reports the reason as 'excluded'; pilot/order.py repeats an excluded run's position. Keys are run IDs, which hold the agent number at the time of the run.

void_first_pilot._comment: History only: exclusions of the void first pilot (2026-10-06, ~/.naoqi-pilot/runs), in its old agent numbers (old A6 = agy + Gemini 3.8 Flash, now A7). Not read by any script.
